{{Quote|Only little Fishface princess left from original family, Purists hunt to kill her, you want Villie smuggle her off planet, all correct?|[[Vilmarh Grahrk]], to [[Foolookoola]]'s uncles|<ref name="Deal">{{Tales|3|Deal with a Demon}}</ref>}}
On the [[Ocean/Legends|oceanic]] planet of [[Ootoola]], during the final decades of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''dynasty''' ruled whose patriarch served both as monarch and priest.<ref name="CEI">{{CSWECite|I|276|Fishfice}}</ref> Around [[33 BBY/Legends|33 BBY]],<ref name="NEGC">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> some [[Ootoolan]]s deemed the reigning patriarch not «pure» enough for his position.<ref name="Deal" /> [[Revolutionary Purist Council|Dissenters]] sent thugs to kill the current patriarch and his wife,<ref name="CEI2">{{CSWECite|I|285|Foolookoola}}</ref> and, after the assassination , appointed a new «pure» patriarch to seize the throne. Only [[Princess/Legends|princess]] [[Foolookoola]] survived from the royal family, and a hunt for her began. With the help of her uncles, her [[Mistryl Shadow Guard]] guardian [[Naradan D'ulin]], and a hired [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Vilmarh Grahrk]], Foolookoola successfully left the planet. The fugitive heiress was given shelter on [[Dur Sabon]] by friends of the royal family.<ref name="Deal" />
